title: Quick Adventurous Norwegian Cod Roast
description: A flavorful and adventurous Norwegian-inspired cod roast dish, served with a tangy mustard sauce and crispy vegetables. This recipe is perfect for a quick and easy weeknight dinner.
instructions: Rinse the cod fillets and pat them dry with paper towels.
Season the cod with salt and black pepper.
In a skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the asparagus to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until tender.
Transfer the cod to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Top the cod with the asparagus and sprinkle with mustard seeds.
Roast in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or until the cod is cooked through.
Meanwhile, mix the lemon juice with chopped fresh dill in a small bowl.
Remove the cod from the oven and brush with the lemon-dill mixture.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional dill if desired.
